content: Si Jeremias wey si Pashur
Dutun he timpu, is memumuhat he si Pashur he anak ni Imer, iyan kinelevawan he upisyal ziyà te valey te Nengazen. Ne hein nezineg din is menge lalag ni Jeremias,
impevuǥel zin heini ne impepirisu zin diyà te uvey te ǥemawan te valey te Nengazen he migngezanan te Pultahan ni Benjamin.

Ne sunud he andew impeǥawas ni Pashur si Jeremias. Ne migkeǥiyan sikandin ni Jeremias te, “Pashur, mid-ilisan en te Nengazen is ngazan nu. Guntaan iyan en igngazan kenikew si Magor Misabib (he ke và dà egkegiya, ‘Is Etew he Layun Egkeherati’).

Su iyan heini migkaǥi te Nengazen: Igkeherati nu is kebpekesavuk nu wey is kebpekesavuk te langun he menge emiǥu nu. Egkeseksiyan nu is kebpenhimetayi kandan te menge kuntada zan diyà te tebek. Ibeǥey ku is tivuuk he Juda ziyà te hadì te Babilonia. Is duma he menge meǥinged kayi ebpenhimetayan, ne is duma ebihaǥen.

Ibeǥey ku te menge kuntada is langun he ketiǥeyunan diyà te inged he Jerusalem: is langun he midheǥuan dan, is langun he mahalen he menge azen wey is langun he ketiǥeyunan te menge hadì te Juda. Edleglaǥen dan heini is langun diyà te Babilonia.
Ne minsan sikew Pashur, wey is tivuuk he pemilya nu, ebihaǥen diyà te Babilonia. Diyè ka ebpatey te Babilonia wey idleveng, ragkes is langun he menge emiǥu nu he tarù is tagnè nu mehitenged kandan.”
Midriklemuwan ni Jeremias is Nengazen
He Nengazen, midlimbungan a kenikew wey mibpildi. Nehimu a he ed-eengitan te menge etew, ne kenè e zan ed-engkezan te edsudì.
Su emun egkaǥi a ne ibpengulahì ku is kebpendaagdaag wey kezeetan. Ne iyan heini he menge lalag is ebpuun diyà te kenikew igkeengiti wey igkesudii kedì.

Usahay ebpekekaǥi a te kenà ad egkaǥi mehitenged kenikew wey ebpenudtul te menge lalag nu. Piru kenè ku egkeeǥen, su is menge lalag nu henduen be te hapuy he egkeregreg diyà te gehinawa ku wey menge tulan ku. Neveley a te ked-eǥen kayi para kenè ku pezem mekaǥi.

Nezineg ku is ked-undaunda kedì te menge etew. Ke sikandan te, “Mekaharatharat is nekeliǥuy! Idsumbung tew sikandin!” Minsan is langun he menge emiǥu ku, edtaǥad he mesayep a. Ke sikandan te, “Kela ke egkelimbungan tew sikandin. Ne egkelupig tew sikandin ne ebpekevales kiw.”

Piru zuma ku sikew, Nengazen. Iring ka te mevurut he sundaru, umbe is menge edal-as kedì egkezeetan wey kenà edlampus. Egkepeel-elezan sikandan ne kenè dan edlampus, ne kenà egkelipatan is keelezan dan taman te taman.
He Nengazen he Mekeǥeǥehem, netuenan nu ke hentei is metazeng. Netuenan nu is gehinawa wey isip te etew. Ipeehè nu kedì is penimales nu kandan, su insarig ku kenikew is kasu ku.
Egkanta kiw wey edalig te Nengazen! Su midlibri zin is menge egkengaayu-ayu puun te ǥehem te menge etew he lalung.
Piru ǥuntaan ingkeepes ku is andew te ked-enaka kedì! Wazè ku ikesuat is andew te ked-enaka kedì te iney ku.
Midrewakan ku is etew he migkaǥi ziyà te amey ku te, “Maama is anak nu!” he utew ingkelipey te amey ku.

Deyzey ke heeyan he etew egkeiring te menge inged he midezeetan te Nengazen he wazè din mehizuwi is menge meǥinged duen. Berakat he mezineg din seled te tivuuk he andew is erang wey kulehian dutun te timpu te tebek.
Su wazè e zin himetayi hein diyè e pa te ǥetek te iney ku. Ne iyan en pezem egkehimu he leveng ku is getek te iney ku.
Maan is neetew e pa? Te iyan dè bes egkeehè ku is keǥuvut wey kelised, ne ebpatey a te kegkeeled?
